title: docs(spec): describe objectui's normaliseOptions as it is at the console pin
body:
Fixes #24047
Clause-②: no

## What changes

Three comments in `packages/spec` still said that objectui's `normaliseOptions` rebuilds each option a field-backed action param inherits as a bare `{ label, value }` pair. At the console pin it keeps every key by spread. This PR rewrites the three comments and adds a prose-only changeset. Nothing else changes.

- `packages/spec/src/ui/action.zod.ts`, the `ActionParam` `options` docblock. The paragraph that began "What this does NOT fix" said the drop "is tracked in objectui". It now describes objectui at the pin, with file, lines and pin sha. It also gives the reason that is still true for the guidance not prescribing "make it field-backed and inherit": the keys survive the resolver, but nothing in this repo measures a reader of `color`, `icon` or `disabled` on the inherited path.
- `packages/spec/src/ui/action.zod.ts`, the comment above the option shape's `guidance` table. Same correction. It points at the docblock for the pin and line.
- `packages/spec/src/ui/action.test.ts`, the comment inside `keeps each rejection pointing at where that vocabulary IS real`. Same correction.
- `.changeset/24047-action-param-options-comments.md`: `'@objectstack/spec': patch`, prose only (see "Changeset" below).

No `guidance` string, schema, export or message text changes. All 34 changed lines in `packages/spec` are `*` or `//` comment lines. The mechanical check is under Verification.

## The pin reading

`.objectui-sha` = `f8267df93aba8fb09cc1cc0692eadc0c8c5a5e56`. I read the files with `git show PIN:PATH` from the local objectui object store.

- `packages/fields/src/resolveActionParams.ts:503` declares `normaliseOptions`. Line `:515` is `return { ...raw, label, value: raw.value };`.
- Lines `:650`-`:651` hold the field-backed branch, `authoredOptions ?? normaliseOptions(field.options, ownerName, param.field, ctx.fieldOptionLabel)`. An authored list still wins over the inherited one.
- Line `:241` is in the `resolveOptionLabels` docblock. It names objectui `fbc23e094` as the change that made `normaliseOptions` keep keys.

The card quoted `:503` at objectui `main` `94b2489f`. At the pin the return is on `:515`, the line the claim also read.

## Readers on the inherited path: a source read at the pin, not a runtime measurement

The card asked for any reader measurement to go here, not into a comment. I read the dialog path at the same pin:

- `packages/app-shell/src/views/ActionParamDialog.tsx:536` re-spreads each option to localise its label (`{ ...o, label: pickLocalized(o.label, language) }`). Inherited keys survive this step as well.
- `packages/app-shell/src/utils/paramToField.ts:102` passes `options: param.options` into the widget's field metadata unchanged.
- The four option widgets build each option from `value` and `optionDisplayLabel(option)` and nothing else:
  - `packages/fields/src/widgets/SelectField.tsx:227-230`
  - `MultiSelectField.tsx:191-206`
  - `RadioField.tsx:134-145`
  - `CheckboxesField.tsx:152-168`

  `optionDisplayLabel` (`packages/core/src/evaluator/optionRules.ts:173`) reads only `label` and `value`. Each `disabled` in those four files is the field-level `props.disabled` (`SelectField.tsx:213`, `MultiSelectField.tsx:201`, `RadioField.tsx:129`, `CheckboxesField.tsx:163`), never a per-option one. None of the four files reads `color` or `icon`.

So at the pin, an inherited option's `color`, `icon` and `disabled` reach the widget, and none of the four widgets reads them. That matches the current `guidance` texts, so this PR proposes no `guidance` change; the card puts any such change on a card of its own anyway. This reading has limits. It is a static source read of the four widgets the docblock already names, not a rendered dialog, and no test in this repo pins it. For that reason the comments say "not measured from this repo" and do not say "no reader".

## Changeset

The card allowed no changeset, or a prose-only `patch` changeset if a gate requires one. `Check Changeset` requires either a changeset or the `skip-changeset` label. `@objectstack/spec`'s `files` array ships `src/**/*.zod.ts`, so the rewritten docblock in `src/ui/action.zod.ts` goes into the published tarball verbatim. "Publishes nothing" would therefore be false, and the changeset is the accurate declaration. Its body carries `Clause-②: no`.

- `pnpm --filter @objectstack/spec check:generated`: exit 0, `All 14 generated artifacts are up to date`. The rewritten docblock reaches no generated artifact. `check:api-surface` reports `public API surface + factory signatures unchanged`, and `check:docs` reports `227 generated files in sync`.
- `node scripts/pm/dispatch-gates.mjs --commands --repo objectstack-ai/objectstack` derived 85 commands. All 85 exit 0. `--ran` reconciliation: `85 derived, 85 run, 0 NOT-MEASURED, 0 UNRUN`. Among them, `check:nul-bytes` reports OK, `check-empty-changeset` reports 1 declaring changeset added, and `check-changeset-no-major` reports no `major` bump.
- On the pre-merge head the same sweep had three exit-3 results (`PREREQUISITE NOT MET`: `check:doc-formula-expressions`, `check:dual-build-cjs-loads`, `check:lean-entry-closure`), because their input packages were not built. After a build of `@objectstack/formula`, `@objectstack/lint` and `@objectstack/objectql`, all three exit 0 on the final head.

- Comment-only check: `git diff -U0 origin/main...HEAD -- packages/spec` has 34 changed lines, and 0 of them start with anything other than `*` or `//`. A control-byte scan of the three files finds nothing.
- No ablation: the diff changes no tested behaviour.
- Not run locally, left to CI: `test:repo` (Test Core), the type-check lanes, and the families `dispatch-gates` lists outside its runnable set.
- Since the merge, `origin/main` has gained two `packages/lint`-only commits. Neither touches the three files here.

## Acceptance notes

- `packages/spec/CHANGELOG.md` still describes the old drop in two entries (lines 40254 and 73939). Both are release-owned history. AGENTS.md routes any change to a released entry through a dedicated docs-only PR, so this PR leaves them as they are.
- The same `options` docblock has a `visibleWhen` bullet that says objectui's inline branch "does `options: param.options`". At the pin, the inline branch returns `options: authoredOptions` (`resolveActionParams.ts:574`), which is `resolveOptionLabels(param.options, ctx.locale)`. That call returns the list untouched when every label is already a string, and rebuilds it by spread otherwise. So the bullet's point, that the list is lowered verbatim, still holds; only the quoted expression is out of date. The claim's file surface names only the two comment blocks above, so this PR does not edit the bullet. Carrier: none.

## Deviations

- Labels: none written. The dispatch's write budget names `git push`, one `pr_create` and the report comment, and no label write.
